verdict.comment: It might be worth sticking with the resurgent BEARAWAY (nap) who made it 2-3 for his new yard when scoring at Wolverhampton last month.

comments.bearaway: Form figures of 121 for new yard and the first two runs were over C&D; big player again
comments.bookoflife: Bounced back with smooth win at Wolverhampton (9.4f) and he's respected at this new trip
comments.crafter: Won over C&D in November but he's not posed a serious threat since; needs to find more
comments.graffiti: On workable mark back on the Flat and needs checking in market on his return
comments.kingmont: Has found things tough in handicaps and needs a hood to make a difference
comments.meetmeinmeraki: Won at Wolverhampton last month but was a well-held third behind Book Of Life there latest
comments.naasma: Has won when fresh in the past but this is competitive and her last win was at 2m
comments.obsidianknight: Four-time course winner who bounced back with a clear second over C&D latest; in the mix
comments.solanna: Has form figures of 3121 since November and both wins were gained on Polytrack; respected

races.raceComment: crafter is marginally preferred with a score of 52.1%, holding clear edges in more progressive over solanna. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: The classy Shartash is much respected on his first run in a handicap but FERROUS came to hand early last spring and gets the nod.

comments.emaraatyana: Struggled in Dubai last month but given a chance by the handicapper; shortlist material
comments.ferrous: Good record on AW and can go well fresh; should make a bold bid
comments.intervention: On losing run but well weighted & sharper for last week's return; this looks tough though
comments.mumstipple: Had a miserable run through in this race 12 months ago; now 11lb lower but not solid
comments.princeofpillo: Smart 2yo; ready win over C&D this month (after a break); not sure to back it up
comments.rohaan: On a good mark and ran well last week but he'll need luck in running from stall 1
comments.shartash: Came to hand early last year before struggling in hot sprints; contender at this level
comments.silkywilkie: Effective over C&D but he's been struggling in Dubai this year; dangerous mark though
comments.thethamesboatman: C&D winner; not seen to best effect here latest; needs a career best but it's possible

races.raceComment: thethamesboatman is marginally preferred with a score of 52.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over rohaan. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 6 wins from 16 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: With further improvement plausible, Irish raider GENOAH is taken to complete a hat-trick. Charlotte's Web is second choice.

comments.charlottesweb: Progressive filly who is 4-4 since handicapping and gained the last two wins over C&D
comments.civillaw: Creditable sixth in this race last year but was in better form at the time
comments.dragonicon: Back in better form since being gelded and this return to 1m2f is worth exploring
comments.genoah: Irish 4yo who scored at Dundalk the last twice and could well improve further; respected
comments.kindofkiss: Ex-French 4yo who is far from solid judged on his two British efforts
comments.kingscode: In good form at Wolverhampton since November; faces a stiffer task in this field
comments.penzance: Won this race in 2024 prior to running well in the Easter Classic; big player on that form
comments.royalapproval: Won narrowly at Newcastle this month, taking record to 2-4; may progress further
comments.stormcatcher: Has to overcome a career-high mark and lack of recent match practice
comments.theglenrovers: Good effort last time took his form figures in AW handicaps to 113114; improving 6yo
comments.urbansprawl: Consistent on AW since last turf win; however, he's now 0-13 in this sphere
comments.youthfulking: Creditable third in this contest 12 months ago; absent since October

races.raceComment: charlottesweb is marginally preferred with a score of 58.0%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over theglenrovers. Won 4 of last 5 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 5 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 4/8 at lingfield. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: Fantastic Fox looks a solid candidate but the classy WITCH HUNTER can defy top weight granted some luck in running.

comments.blueprince: Yet to convince at 1m but should stay the trip around here; others stronger for the win
comments.cynosure: C&D win last spring; two good handicap runs before lesser effort latest; cheekpieces now
comments.destructive: 2-2 back from break (after gelding operation); up another 6lb but more appealing than many
comments.fantasticfox: C&D winner; ran right up to his best when 2nd at Newcastle last month; contender
comments.iamsuperman: Irish raider; not beaten far at Dundalk last week but more is required this time
comments.kalamunda: Progressive handicapper; good second over C&D six weeks ago; should run his race again
comments.sterlingknight: Comes here in good form but others appeal more for win purposes
comments.talisevolvere: Won on Good Friday last year; repeat of that success likely to be the main aim; fair mark
comments.witchhunter: Group 1 placed last year; capable off this mark but he'll need them to go fast early

races.raceComment: talisevolvere is marginally preferred with a score of 57.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form and superior course form over fantasticfox. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 5/19 at lingfield. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for KING OF ITHACA, who has solid C&D form. Mereside Madness is second choice.

comments.bombsquad: All wins in Class 6, latest over C&D last week; no certainty to defy a 4lb penalty
comments.cliffcake: Took well to first-time cheekpieces in 6f event here this month; effective over 7f
comments.goldenpharaoh: Ex-French; 0-6 in Britain but ran encouragingly in higher grade over C&D last week
comments.kingofithaca: Record over 1312 over C&D; very close third at Kempton most recently; solid claims
comments.kristalklear: Good spell last August-October featured two wins; disappointing on final outing
comments.meresidemadness: Good second at Newcastle last week and is due to go up 1lb in future; respected
comments.secretstrength: Won at Lingfield eight weeks ago on stable debut; Southwell is an unknown
comments.superhit: Held off this mark in both starts for new yard and needs to raise his game

races.raceComment: meresidemadness is marginally preferred with a score of 53.7%, holding clear edges in more progressive over cliffcake. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
